direct_observation: At p27 both OFF and ON accept two drafts. At p78/P8237 OFF accepts three and ON suffix accepts two. All later 43 rounds in each arm accept three, so the one-token lag persists to the ordinary tail.
tail_policy: At k=3 MtpGenerationStepFits requires output_remaining>4. OFF reaches 254 emitted (2 remaining), ON 253 (3 remaining). Ordinary decode emits pending immediately and forwards only before subsequent nonfinal tokens: 1 versus 2 T1 forwards.
limits: Native logs contain acceptance and suffix source but not token IDs or selected match; those are joined from the earlier exact per-token decode/index replay after output hash identity.
Full and subset timing agree, but the four instrumented requests are diagnostics, not additional E2E acceptance replicates.
Same accepted/output token prefix does not prove identical internal draft state or floating-point reduction paths after different proposal/extend histories.
Rejecting p78 in a new policy would execute an unobserved neural proposal at that candidate state. OFF a3 supports the mechanism but is not a counterfactual oracle.
The p27 length7 partial is not an observed added-target-work cause; its OFF neural proposal also accepted two.
Original and numeric query selection are identical before the numeric admission gate; production numeric replay independently verifies selected-match identity.
